data.name: Photon Rush
data.detailed_description:
Race, dodge, focus, block, destroy, and MUCH MORE in HIGH-SPEED! Your job is to maneuver your vehicle between obstacles and try to block, trick play or destroy the others. Map get smaller every second so watch your back and try to stay alive as long as you can.




Yes, really, 16 players on one screen!
Invite all your friends and play together.
This is one of few games that can do that!
Can you imagine fun playing with so many friends in one room?


No one will get bored. Action is VERY FAST and one round takes just about 30 seconds.
You won’t have time to use bathroom!


Stamina comes to your aid charging slowly.
You can use it to run faster or slower and to
block opponents steering ability in small area around you.
Different bonuses will appear in random spots on the map,
you can pick them up and use later.


You can use your gamepad from console.
We support all popular gamepads and much more.


You need only one hand to play Photon Rush, you can reach snacks or hold drink and play at the same time. There is no problem if you have limited number of gamepads, we got it covered! Two players can play games simultaneously using only one gamepad!
Also isn't it perfect excuse to get closer to your date?


Explosion Blast
You can destroy obstacles, players and balls. Shielded players are immune.

Shield
While being shielded you can go through obstacles, balls and players.
You cannot leave map, walls will destroy you.

Death Zone
You can create zone blocking steering abilities of your opponents.
Inside the zone bonuses or powers (stamina) can be used.


Player Vehicle has frontside and backside.
If you hit opponent backside with your frontside - you lose.
If you hit opponent frontside with your frontside - you both lose.

reviews.review:
(Review updated to reflect the latest changes)

[h1]Verdict[/h1]
Photon Rush is a cool and fun [b]local[/b] multiplayer game for 2-16 players in splitscreen.
A neat feature is the ability to have 2 players per controller which is great for party sessions.
Game now supports multiple monitors.
Price has been adjusted and is fair now so buy it if you have friend/s to play locally with.

[h1]My thoughts about the game[/h1]
Fun competitive gameplay:
+ Blocking enemies and killing them with well timed power-ups is rewarding.
+ Round based games are especially fun since there is a target indicator marking the player in the lead helping players cooperate to take out the leader.

[b]Party game:[/b]
+ Pick up and play
  It's easy to understand the game, the controls are simple and the analog steering works very well and is more intuitive than the 90 degree turns of the classic Light Cycle games.
+ Supports a lot of players
  Up to 16 players if you have a big screen
+ Several players per input device:
  2 players per gamepad and up to 4 keyboard players with 2 keyboards.
+ Supports multiple monitors.

[b]Game modes and modifiers:[/b]
Game modes:
Death match - The only game mode in the game so I'm glad it's fun. There are several power-ups and also stamina based abilities to speed up, slow down and block opponents' steering if within range. I think the power-ups are well designed since several of them can both be used as offensive weapons or save you from smashing into a trail. Power-ups can also be stacked so you can pick up as many of them as you want.

Modifiers:
Random Blocks - Random blocks that spawn in the level. 
Snake blocks - Blocks spiralling in from the outer walls making the arena smaller as time progresses.

It would be cool to have more game modes and modifiers to play around with. I've suggested this in the forums and the developers are open to suggestions so hopefully something like this will be added later on.
If you check out the forum you can see that there is  a file you can create/modify to alter some variables in the game if you want to do some tweaking.

[b]Visuals:[/b]
Visuals are OK. They are more crisp now after the latest update so it's easier to see what's going on. Still think it would be nice to have an option to remove the floor grid altogether so the obstacles and walls are even easier to see without the floor lights.

[b]Local multiplayer only:[/b]
There is currently no single player content or online multiplayer support. 
Not really an issue for me though since I'm into local multiplayer gaming but it would be cool if there were AI players since that would both enable single player and the possibility of adding AI players to local multiplayer rounds.

[b]Performance:[/b]
Performance has been improved a lot!
I now get a steady [b]60 FPS[/b] with 16 players on my machine with these specs:

Processor: Intel Core(TM) i5-4690K CPU @ 3.50 GHz (4 cores)
Ram: 8GB
Graphics: NVIDI GeForce GTX 970
OS: Windows 10
